title: reference-integrity-v1 player output
description: Per-reference integrity judgements. One record per reference (and per dangling in-text marker the player believes has no matching reference).

reference_id.description: Reference id from input.references (or an in_text_marker_id with no matching reference, for a dangling-missing flag).

issue_kind.description: The integrity issue kind when flagged=true; null otherwise. One of: retracted, metadata_mismatch, dangling_uncited, dangling_missing, replication_uncited, miscitation, invalid_doi, predatory_source, tortured_phrase.

flagged.description: True if this reference has an integrity problem.

confidence.description: Player's confidence in the flagged judgement.
